name: container-text-flip
title: Container Text Flip
blurb: Words flip through a cycle with the container growing and shrinking to fit each…
description: Cycles through a list of words with the container animating its width to fit each word. Letters fade in and blur-clear individually as words change. Uses layout animations.
use_when: An inline word swap that needs smooth container resize animations alongside letter reveals.
avoid_when: When word list is very long or words have drastically different widths.
a11y: Current word is rendered and readable; letters are staggered but all DOM elements are present.
